title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave task. Implemented a numerical solver for the porous medium traveling wave ODE using RK45 integration. The model transforms the porous medium equation into a first-order system (f' = g/f^m, g' = -cg/f^m). Verified solutions through residual analysis (mean residuals ~10^-6) and analytical comparison for m=1 case. Generated 5 figures showing wave profiles, derivatives, residuals, wave speed effects, and verification. All deliverables complete: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, and comprehensive report in report/report.md.
